_doc: Everything that carries (PLAN M3 porters + mule cart; M10 appends truck, train, barge). Speeds in metres a second (a cell is 0.5 m, a tick 1/20 s). On foot the cell's own walk % applies (shallow water 35%, trees 55%) and `road` multiplies on a road or bridge. A wheeled carrier (`wheels: true`) can only use cells whose material says `vehicle: true`, or a road / bridge; it moves at `road` x speed on a road and `offRoad` x speed off it. `load` = ticks to load or unload.
